headline: Continued hearing on variance for 86 Dessa Drive side yard setback to November 19, 2026.
summary: The request for a 7-foot side yard setback at 86 Dessa Drive, where 12 feet is required, was continued to November 19, 2026. The applicant asked to defer deliberations. Members also approved the minutes of the September 3, 2026 meetings.
decisions: Continued the hearing on Variance #26-6740 at 86 Dessa Drive to November 19, 2026, with all in favor.
Approved the September 3, 2026 Public Hearing and Special Meeting minutes as written, with all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Provenzano moved to continue the hearing for Variance #26-6740 to the November meeting. Commissioner Saravis-Foote seconded and all were in favor. The hearing was continued to November 19, 2026.
Commissioner Provenzano moved to approve the minutes as written, seconded by Commissioner Brantley. All were in favor and the minutes were approved.

October 20, 2026 
The Hamden Zoning Board of Appeals held a hybrid Public Hearing and Regular Meeting on 
Thursday, October 15, 2026 at 7:00pm. The meeting was held in-person in the 3rd Floor Conference 
Room at Hamden Government Center (2750 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518) and remotely 
via Town Zoom teleconferencing software at https://hamden.zoom.us/j/82445626188. 
 
Commissioners in Attendance: 
 
In Person: Paul Fioretti (Chairman), Nancy Saravis-Foote, John 
Brantley 
Via Zoom: Francesca Provenzano 
  Staff in Attendance: In Person: Eugene Livshits (Town Planner), Maisie Albis 
(Commission Clerk) 
  
Chairman Fioretti called the meeting to order at 7:14 p.m. Board members and staff introduced 
themselves.  
 
A. Public Comment Session 
  Chairman Fioretti called for public comments relating to topics within purview of Board that 
were not already on the agenda. There were no attendees, either online or in-person. The Chairman 
closed the public comment session. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
B. Regular Meeting 
 1. Variance #26-6740 
86 Dessa Drive 
Applicant: Lisa Haylon 
Variance requested from: 
(1) Section 220 Table 2.3 
i. requesting 7-foot side yard setback where a minimum of 12 feet is required 
Chairman Fioretti explained that the applicant had been informed of the fact that any decision 
would require the concurring votes of all four members present. He reported that Ms. Haylon had 
confirmed to the clerk via email that she would like to defer deliberations until the next meeting.  
The Chairman called for a motion to continue the item to the meeting of November 19, 2026. 
Commissioner Provenzano moved to continue the hearing for Variance #26-6740 to the 
November meeting. Commissioner Saravis-Foote seconded and all were in favor. The 
hearing was continued to November 19, 2026.

C. Regular Meeting 
 1. Variance #26-6740 
86 Dessa Drive 
Applicant: Lisa Haylon

i. requesting 7-foot side yard setback where a minimum of 12 feet is required 
No discussion; Public Hearing for Variance #26-6740 continued to November 19, 2026. 
 
 D. Old Business 
 
 
 
1. Review of September 3, 2026, Public Hearing and Special Meeting minutes 
 Chairman Fioretti confirmed that members had an opportunity to review the minutes despite 
physical copies not being distributed at the meeting. Commissioner Provenzano moved to 
approve the minutes as written, seconded by Commissioner Brantley. All were in favor and 
the minutes were approved.  
   
E. New Business 
 
 
 
 
      
 No new business was introduced. 
 
F. Adjournment  
 Commissioner Saravis-Foote made a motion to adjourn. Commissioner Brantley seconded 
and all were in favor. Chairman Fioretti adjourned the meeting at 7:21 p.m.
